parameters: By all that is sacred, the darkness beckons from our very doorstep.\! Army of Embor, rest will not come until we have cleansed this land in Donar's name.\! I give my life for Embor... Donar give us strength!
No friend of the defenders of Dakur will be left behind!\! We shall lay down our lives to defend Duke Jaromir and the innocent people of Embor! Survive for just a little longer, Jaromir...
Praise to the heavens, our prayers answered... an army of the divine arrives.\! And may my faith be never shaken!
